name: Zyrn
tagline: Iyong store. Iyong brand. Iyong customers — notified agad.
description:
## About Zyrn

Zyrn is a complete digital commerce package for business owners and new entrepreneurs who want to sell online without drowning in spreadsheets, WhatsApp orders, and sticky notes. It runs a real store — products, payments, customers, marketing, returns, reports — and grows into subscriptions, digital goods, bookings, and automations that keep your business moving while you sleep.

### No paper trail. No guessing.

Orders stop living in Instagram DMs and chat threads. Stock stops living in notebooks. Customers get updates the moment something changes — order placed, payment confirmed, shipped, delivered, return opened.

### Sell what you actually sell

Physical products, digital downloads, subscriptions and memberships, bookings and appointments, bundles and multi-currency storefronts — one branded system, not a brochure site.

hero.title: Magbenta nang mas matalino. Manatiling malapit sa customers. Lumago nang walang kaguluhan.
hero.subtitle: Branded online store para sa physical, digital, at subscription products — may live updates, malinaw na numbers, at automations para hindi ka mag-guess sa negosyo.

features.title: Branded Storefront
features.description: Your logo, colors, and content on a mobile-ready store — premium from day one, not a temporary link in bio.

features.title: Sell Anything
features.description: Physical products, digital downloads, subscriptions, bookings, bundles, and multi-currency or multi-language storefronts.

features.title: Notified on the Spot
features.description: Order placed → payment confirmed → shipped → delivered → return opened. Customers stay informed without chasing you.

features.title: Checkout & Payments
features.description: Smooth cart and checkout with cards, wallets, COD, bank transfer, and major gateways — take the money, confirm, move on.

features.title: Marketing & Growth
features.description: Coupons, catalog rules, email campaigns, SEO, social share, and newsletter tools — offers, timing, and follow-through.

features.title: Live Statistics
features.description: Sales, bestsellers, customers, carts, promotions, inventory — open the numbers and decide what to do next.

features.title: Automations
features.description: Order emails, status alerts, promotion rules, stock signals, and extendable flows like cart recovery and WhatsApp updates.

features.title: Inventory & Team Control
features.description: Stock that updates with sales, import/export, returns/RMA, and staff roles so your team works from one system.

faq.question: I already sell on Instagram. Why do I need Zyrn?
faq.answer: Instagram is discovery. Zyrn is checkout, stock, notifications, and ownership of the customer relationship — so orders stop living in DMs.

faq.question: Can’t I just use a form?
faq.answer: Forms take requests. Zyrn takes payment, tracks inventory, and updates the customer automatically when something changes.

faq.question: I’m too small for software. Is this for me?
faq.answer: That is exactly when chaos starts. Zyrn keeps a small business clean before the mess becomes expensive — launch lean, add subscriptions, digital, and automations later.

faq.question: Can I sell digital products or subscriptions?
faq.answer: Yes. Instant delivery for downloads and licenses, plus subscription and membership flows for boxes, plans, and recurring revenue.

faq.question: Will customers know what is happening with their order?
faq.answer: Yes. Notified on the spot — order, payment, shipping, and returns — so you are not typing the same update fifty times a day.

faq.question: How do I know what to sell next?
faq.answer: Statistics. Bestsellers. Customer behavior. Cart and promotion views. No guessing — open the dashboard and decide.
